item.title: Multichannel Lockin v3.7.0.86
item.description:
Product: Multichannel Lockin v3.7.0.86
Company: LevyLab
Release Date: Thu, 01 Oct 2026 19:18:08 -0400
Packager: Patrick Irvin

Description: Multichannel Lockin for National Instruments' Dynamic Signal Acquisition hardware (4431, 4461, 4462).
- This version is configured to handle multiple cards for simultaneous, synchronized AI/AO.
- The analog outputs can be configured to output sine, square, sawtooth, or triangle functions with (swept) DC offsets.
- Each of the analog inputs can be demodulated at multiple frequencies.

Release Notes: ## 3.6.5.86

- #175 The actual sample clock rate is reported to the Generator and the UI. DAQmx can coerce the requested rate (on a USB-4431 with AO sharing the clock, 102.4 kS/s runs at 96 kS/s). The event carries only the sample rate and samples per block.
- #160 DAQmx self-recovery after AO underflow (-200621) works again.
- Performance: `Mixer subVI.vi` (#173), `Initialize Filter State.vi` and `Wrap Phase.vi` are inlined; `Match Key Regex.vi` no longer uses a regex (130 to 30 us per call); Generator `Process.vi` no longer queues extra states on every 10 ms timeout; duplicate State History VIs are replaced by `Instrument:State History.vi`.
- Built with the Logger.Error release that fixes levylabpitt/Logger.Error #1 (the logger's CPU use grew with uptime).
item.dc:creator: LevyLab

item.title: XY Utilities v1.9.1.14
item.description:
Product: XY Utilities v1.9.1.14
Company: PRIrvin
Release Date: Thu, 01 Oct 2026 15:28:11 -0400
Packager: Patrick Irvin

Description: Utilities for working with XY-data type (Cluster of 1D X and Y arrays).

Supported methods:
- <b>Arithmetic</b>: Add, Subtract, Multiply, Divide, Square, Log
- <b>Array</b>: Sort, Reverse, Decimate, Decimate Array, Subset, Swap X and Y, Get X and Y, Append, Restrict X Range, Remove Outliers
- <b>Signal Processing</b>: Derivative, Average, Moving Average, Interpolate, Interpolate Parameter, Resample, FFT Spectrum, FFT Power Spectrum, Symmetrize
- <b>Filters</b>: Zero Phase Low Pass, Savitsky-Golay,
- <b>Conversion</b>: Waveform to XY, XY to Waveform, 2D to XY, XY to 2D

Release Notes: change Circular Buffer subVI reentrancy
item.dc:creator: PRIrvin
